intent: Close the JANUS learning loop with a Spider attention ecology: recurring patterns become salient enough to inspect, stale repetition saturates and loses attention, fresh evidence can renew attention, dynamic focus centers migrate across the graph, and PIPPI reflects the result to Pivot-Slime and Keymaster before the next pass.

weight_model.evidence_weight: Conservative relationship/discovery weight; replay is not new evidence.
weight_model.attention_weight: Volatile discovery salience. Early repetition may boost it for inspection, replay fatigue later suppresses it.
weight_model.node_attention_A_t: Dynamic focus on graph nodes from incident attention plus bounded spiral-ring propagation.

ecology.phase_1: Pattern appears or repeats and gains temporary salience.
ecology.phase_2: Spider/TOPA inspect the pattern while it holds attention.
ecology.phase_3: If repetition adds no new information, saturation/fatigue dominates and attention decays.
ecology.phase_4: Freed attention flows to other graph regions; focus centers may migrate or die.
ecology.phase_5: Fresh independent evidence may reactivate a stale pattern.
ecology.metaphor: A bounded information ecosystem, like a closed jar: attention is recycled rather than permanently captured by repeated noise.

pippi_cycle: PIPPI opens the pass with previous mirror/accounting state.
JUXTAPOSE + Exact JANUS generate verified route receipts.
JGPT Teacher and Pivot-Slime learn/propose routes.
TOPA Detective Spider weaves relationships and runs spiral attention ecology.
Exact JANUS replay alone decides proof/search semantics.
Spider re-chunks PIPPI, updates relations and dynamic attention.
TOPA CORE attacks newly salient interpretations.
PIPPI Mirror records gains, regressions, focus migration, rising patterns and stale/saturated patterns.
Pivot-Slime and Keymaster read the mirror before the next pass.

verified_live_topa_run.interpretation_limit: The live pipeline verifies integration over two passes. Long replay saturation/decay is validated by deterministic engine self-test, not inferred from only two live passes.
